summary: Every readable graded expectation (15 plain-text families, 32 hand-built batches) is determined by instruction.md plus SOP TM-07 and the shipped code's fallback calculations, and no contradiction, hidden convention or representation-specific check was found. The axis cannot be cleared as None because the two gzip families (generated.jsonl.gz with 24 batches, capacity.jsonl.gz with 1 batch) are binary and could not be read in this packet-only, read-only review.

unread_or_truncated_ranges: tests/expected/generated.jsonl.gz: gzip binary; the Read tool refuses binary files and no decompression is permitted in this review (24 graded batches unread)
tests/expected/capacity.jsonl.gz: gzip binary; the Read tool refuses it (1 graded 80-run, 4-analyte batch unread)

checks_performed: Mapped every graded field in tests/test_outputs.py compare() (top keys, entry key sets, exact id/analyte/flag/ccv_ok/pass, numeric value/recovery/blank_levels with 1e-6 rel/abs) to instruction.md:7 and SOP section 8
Mapped each SOP rule (sections 2-7) to the shipped defect in calib.py, blanks.py, samples.py and qc.py and to its named test family

Hand-recomputed every row of the 15 plain-text expected families from the SOP. For the no-rule cases I used the shipped fallbacks: the first blank's reading (0 when there is no blank), the nearest earlier CCV (true when there is none), and (spike amount - parent amount)/(added*dilution). SOP readings and amounts are substituted per instruction.md:5. Every row matched.

Checked that hand-built limit batches use integer or power-of-two responses so that the OLS slope and intercept, readings, the blank mean and corrected readings are exact under any closed-form pure-Python OLS formula; exact-limit flags are therefore not floating-point-order sensitive
Checked CCV rounding cases (90.0, 110.00000000000001, 110.04, 110.06, 89.96, 89.94) against SOP section 1's no-tie guarantee and section 6's inclusive rounded range

Checked that the verifier driver invocation (python3 -I -S, a copy of the driver with src linked to /app/src) matches instruction.md:1-3 and that the environment provides no third-party package a solution could depend on
Checked that the verifier's tolerance and type checks do not reject any contract-valid representation (int vs float accepted, blank_levels key order ignored, null only for ND)

coverage_sweep.category: Every grading rule has a candidate-visible authority
coverage_sweep.reason: Calibration (SOP 2), readings (3), result/non-detect (3), blank mean of results (4), correction before dilution and ND/J/'' flags (5), CCV rounded inclusive pass and two-sided bracketing (6), spike recovery (7) and report shape/order (8) each govern a test family. The no-rule cases (no blank result, runs not bracketed on both sides, ND spike or parent) are resolved by instruction.md:5 together with the visible shipped code in blanks.py:6-9, qc.py:14-17 and qc.py:20-21.

coverage_sweep.category: Input domain and boundaries the task needs
coverage_sweep.reason: SOP section 1 bounds run count, analytes, standards, dilution and counts, keeps CCV readings well above mdl and excludes rounding ties. Exact mdl/loq hits (flag_limits rows 1-3, where mdl==loq in row 2), a blank exactly at mdl (report_order As, M-MB), negative readings and blank levels, dilution 1000 and CCVs within 1e-6-free distance of the 90/110 limits all have hand-computable expectations.

coverage_sweep.category: Rendered instruction, declared artifacts and verifier paths agree
coverage_sweep.reason: The instruction names /app/src/metalquant, /app/tools/metalquant_run.py (to stay byte-identical), /app/docs/reduction-sop.md and /app/examples/. The verifier compares /app/tools/metalquant_run.py to tests/shipped (identical hash in the manifest) and runs its own copy against /app/src. The render is clean and contains no sentinel.

coverage_sweep.category: Examples support the stated rules / hidden fixtures only instantiate the visible model
coverage_sweep.reason: All 32 readable hand-built batches instantiate the visible model and match hand computation. The 24 generated batches and the capacity batch are gzip and unreadable here, so I cannot confirm that they stay inside SOP section 1 or avoid float-order-sensitive limit coincidences. The small example is not graded.

coverage_sweep.category: Contradictions, hidden arbitrary conventions, representation-specific grading, instruction/test asymmetry
coverage_sweep.reason: I found no contradictions. The compare() function parses JSON, ignores blank_levels key order, accepts int or float and uses the disclosed tolerance. The exact fields are the ones instruction.md:7 names. The exact entry key sets match the fields SOP section 8 lists. The value tolerance matches the disclosed numeric comparison.
The model needs only the Python standard library. The verifier runs python3 -I -S as nobody with /app made world-readable, and no step requires writing or network access.

rules: instruction.md:5 keep today's calculation where no rule applies
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Batches whose blanks are all non-detects, including a single negative blank and blanks after the sample: the level is the first blank's reading in run order (0.5, -1.0, 0.25), and 0.0 with no blank. Mixed ND/result blanks average only the results (blank_nondetects rows 1-3).

rules: SOP 5 correction before dilution ('every other step still follows the SOP')
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: blank_no_results row 4: (4.0-0.5)*3=10.5 with flag J. The legacy reading*dilution-level would give 11.5, and the expectation follows the SOP.

Spike or parent ND: (SOP spike amount - SOP parent amount)/(added*spike dilution)*100, e.g. 48.75, -16.0417, -15, 52.5 and report_order As 47.5 / Cd 50.0. When both are results the dilution is dropped from the denominator (380, -150, 160, 112.5).

rules: legacy nearest-earlier CCV for unbracketed runs
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: A run before the first CCV gives true, including when the later CCV failed (W-128). A run after the last CCV takes that CCV's SOP pass (W-123 true, W-125/W-125S false, C-1 per analyte). Bracketed runs are false if either neighbour failed.

The corrected reading exactly equals mdl (J), loq (''), mdl==loq (''), or is 5e-8 below mdl/loq (ND/J), with blank means and dilution exact in binary floating point. The report_order As blank exactly at mdl counts in the mean.
The recoveries 110.00000000000001, 110.04, 110.06, 89.96 and 89.94 are all at least 0.01 from a tie, so the expected pass values do not depend on the rounding mode or operation order.

unresolved_checks.concern: The generated (24) and capacity (1) batches could contain an instance outside SOP section 1, such as a CCV recovery within 1e-6 of a rounding tie, a dilution out of range or a non-earlier spike parent. They could also contain a corrected reading or CCV recovery so close to a limit that the flag or pass depends on floating-point operation order in a contract-valid OLS implementation.
unresolved_checks.missing_evidence: The decompressed contents of tests/expected/generated.jsonl.gz and tests/expected/capacity.jsonl.gz, or a packet-visible text copy, to confirm the domain limits and the minimum distance of generated corrected readings and CCV recoveries from the mdl/loq and 90.0/110.0 rounding limits.

uncertainty: No contract defect was found in any readable surface. The Unsure verdict rests only on 25 graded batches stored as gzip, which the packet-only, read-only rules and the Read tool's refusal of binary files prevented me from inspecting.
